theme: An open Monday, girls in residence in St Pete.
greeting: The whole day is open, Dan — nothing on the calendar. The girls are with you and Mike in St Petersburg through the weekend, so the evening is a family one.

needsAttention.title: Reply to Kevin on the NACDNE committee
needsAttention.detail: Kevin McGovern re-sent the NACD New England note after it bounced from your old KPMG address and is asking if you got it. It's a Maine programming-committee invite, cc'd to the chapter staff, and it's sitting unanswered.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: This p1 is two weeks overdue. A refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week sells out early, so holding a booking now removes the whole risk at no cost.

needsAttention.title: Reschedule the girls' passport appointment
needsAttention.detail: The p1 passport appointment still needs rebooking now that you're back from Croatia. All four books are expired and it's been open since Sept 21.

flagged.title: Governance role alert
flagged.detail: LinkedIn flagged a Senior Director, Government & Multilateral Affairs posting via Jobgether.

flagged.title: BA Visa autopay scheduled
flagged.detail: Chase will run your scheduled British Airways Visa payment on the due date.

flagged.title: Sitter applied on Care.com
flagged.detail: Jessica G. applied to the childcare job you posted.

inbox.noise: Everything else is newsletters and receipts — Responsible Investor, ICGN policy, local events, language drills, and a few promos.

acts.line: The calendar is empty end to end — a rare fully open Monday.
Still clear, so the day bends to whatever's been waiting rather than to meetings.
The girls are in residence in St Pete — a night for cooking at home.
